KIDS ETHNIC WEAR — redrawn

Everything before this was womenswear. Wrong customer. Redrawn for children's ethnic wear: frocks, lehenga cholis, kurta sets, cord sets, sherwanis.

That also explains the reference — House of IQF is a kidswear store too.

Still the same D2C register: announcement bar, MRP struck through, trust strip, category tiles, reviews, dark footer.

SIZES CARRY THE AGE

The single most important change. Your chart exists because 22 does not obviously mean "4 years" — so every size chip shows BOTH:

     22
   4 years

A parent never has to hold the chart in their head. The same pairing appears in the buy bar ("Size 24 · held 14:38"), on the listing filters, and in the shop-by-age tiles on the home page.

A sold-out size is struck through and stays visible, with a restock note — parents will often size up rather than leave.

SIZE GUIDE — its own page

On a kidswear site this is one of the most visited pages, so it is a real page, not a popup: linked from the nav, the footer, and every product page.

Your chart gave age → size. CHEST AND LENGTH IN THIS TABLE ARE MY ESTIMATES and need your real numbers before this ships — chest follows the usual convention that the size number is the chest in inches, but the lengths are guesses.

The "measure a garment that already fits" instruction is there because measuring an actual child rarely goes well.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

1. Real chest and length figures per size, to replace my estimates in the size guide.

2. Do you split Girls / Boys in the nav, or lead with category (Frocks, Kurta sets)? I have assumed both, with Girls/Boys first.

3. Does every style run the full 12–36, or do ranges vary by style as I have shown (this frock runs 16–30)?

4. Free-delivery threshold — I dropped it to ₹1,500 to suit kidswear basket sizes. Right number?

STILL OPEN from before: cash on delivery, and how deep the headline discounts go.
